tax.intro: Choose the VAT rate you normally apply. You can change it quote by quote, including 0% where the law allows it.
tax.viesTitle: What VIES is and why you need it
tax.viesWhat: VIES (VAT Information Exchange System) is the European Commission database that tells you whether a company's VAT number is active for trade between EU countries.
tax.viesWhy: When you sell to a business in another EU country you may invoice at 0% VAT only if its VAT number is active in VIES. Without this check the VAT of your own country applies.
tax.viesHow: In the quote you pick the customer's country and enter their VAT number: the platform queries VIES, stores the result and blocks 0% if the number is invalid or the service does not answer.
tax.rule1: Customer in your own country: national VAT.
tax.rule2: Business in another EU country with an active VIES number: 0% (intra-Community supply, reverse charge).
tax.rule3: Private individual in another EU country: your country's VAT.
tax.rule4: Customer outside the EU (including San Marino and the Vatican): 0% as an export, keeping proof the goods left.
tax.viesDisclaimer: General information built into the calculator, not tax advice: always confirm the rules with your accountant.
tax.viesLink: Check a number on the Commission's VIES site
tax.ack: I understand how VIES works and that 0% requires the check.

priceGuide.title: Standard price list guide
priceGuide.intro: How the prices already in your catalogue work, in plain words. You don't have to enter any price: pick your area and just decide your profit margin.
priceGuide.whatComplete: “Complete” price: finished window with low-emissivity double glazing, standard hardware and basic installation, in euro per square metre (€/m²).
priceGuide.whatFrame: “Frame only” price: the bare window, about {share}% of the complete price.
priceGuide.whatMid: The catalogue uses the middle of each price range (market minimum and maximum), so you start from a realistic price.
priceGuide.zonesIntro: The Italian market costs more in the North and less in the South. Choosing your area makes the platform apply the right list automatically.
priceGuide.zonesDelta: Between North and South the typical difference is 10–15%; the Centre sits in between.
priceGuide.tableTitle: Comparison table of the 12 PVC profiles
priceGuide.tableNote: Prices in €/m² (complete) with, below, the frame only. Bar: € per linear metre. Glass: € per m² of glass alone.
priceGuide.factorsTitle: What raises or lowers the price
priceGuide.factorTriple: Triple glazing: about +40–80 €/m² over double (the platform uses +60 €/m²).
priceGuide.factorColour: Coloured or foil-wrapped frame: about +15–25% over white (the platform uses +20%).
priceGuide.factorOther: Size, opening type, special hardware and installation difficulty can also change the final price.
priceGuide.marginBody: The margin is a percentage added to the price-list price: decimals are allowed (e.g. 12.5%). The platform applies it to the price of each window, rounded to the cent. Markup (on cost) and margin on the selling price are two ways of reading the same profit: you see both.
priceGuide.marginExample: Example: list price {base} + markup {margin}% = {final}. Profit {gain}, i.e. {onPrice}% of the selling price.
priceGuide.methodBody: Italian market prices 2024–2026 collected in the comparison table of PVC profiles, validated by CORE829. Each profile and area has a range; the catalogue uses the middle value.
priceGuide.disclaimerBody: Prices are indicative and are not an offer. Always check the real cost with your supplier: you can edit any catalogue price, nothing is locked.

class.economica: Entry-level 5-chamber profiles: good value for standard renovations.
class.media: More chambers and greater depth: better insulation, the most common choice.
class.mediaSuperiore: High performance (7 chambers, triple gasket, reinforcement): for high thermal comfort.
class.premium: Top of the range (e.g. carbon fibre): the best thermal and mechanical performance.

priceGuide.calibration: Prices used by the platform: supply only, factory transport to the installer included, VAT excluded. The market prices in the table also include the basic installation, so they were reduced by {pct}% (calibrated on a real Winarhi quote: Aluplast Ideal 4000, Centre, 1432 × 1548 mm = 420.00 € excl. VAT). The same reduction applies to every profile and zone.
